_producer: src/6.generate_docs.py — emits archive/${RUN_DATE}/logs/daily_report.json (see _write_daily_report), plus markdown under docs/papers.
_producer_notes: daily_report.json shape: {date, mode, generated_at, recommend_path, recommend_exists, deep_count, quick_count, total_count, docs_dir, day_readme}. Counts are exposed as flat scalars (deep_count / quick_count / total_count); there is no 'written_papers' array on the report. min_count on the existing scalar fields would be a 'min_count' kind which targets a list field, so we tighten it with schema_valid to require all canonical count scalars are present.
